choices.text: [TODO:pl] Pay him only for the donkeys

giveup_consequence.text:
[TODO:pl] Your search is more than donkeys.

pay_consequence.text:
[TODO:pl] He has no need of your silver.
Go and hear his word.

anointing.text:
[TODO:pl] Samuel pours oil and kisses you.
"The Lord has chosen you to lead."

choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] A king kneels before God first.
[TODO:pl] Do not refuse what God gives.
[TODO:pl] The oil runs warm down your brow.

boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:pl] The crown is heavy with calling.

reject_consequence.text:
[TODO:pl] God Himself anoints through Samuel.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Your hands rest open at your side.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] God will still bring you out.

hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:pl] They draw you out into the light.
